expedition_advisor.agent_description: Evaluates party attrition, sweeper move PP, and status conditions for both Mewtwo and Blastoise, and recommends whether to continue switch-training or execute a pit-stop.
expedition_advisor.agent_system_prompt: You are an expedition advisor evaluating party attrition and resources during switch-training in Pokémon Blue (Gen 1). You analyze the active trainee's remaining EXP to the milestone, Mewtwo's HP, status condition (OK, PAR, SLP, PSN, FRZ), and Psychic PP, and Blastoise's HP, status condition (OK, PAR, SLP, PSN, FRZ), and Surf PP. You evaluate status impairments (e.g. paralysis cuts Speed by 75% and incurs a 25% full-paralysis failure chance; sleep disables moves entirely) and retreat thresholds (trigger pit-stop if Mewtwo Psychic PP <= 3 or HP < 60, or Blastoise HP < 60 or Surf PP <= 3, or both sweepers are incapacitated). You output a recommendation ('continue' or 'pit_stop'), detailed reasoning, and estimated battles remaining.
expedition_advisor.agent_input_schema: {"type": "object", "properties": {"trainee_exp_remaining": {"type": "integer", "description": "EXP needed to next level milestone"}, "mewtwo_hp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Current HP for Mewtwo"}, "mewtwo_status": {"type": "string", "description": "Status condition for Mewtwo (e.g. OK, PAR, SLP)"}, "mewtwo_psychic_pp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Remaining PP for Mewtwo's Psychic"}, "blastoise_hp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Current HP for Blastoise"}, "blastoise_status": {"type": "string", "description": "Status condition for Blastoise (e.g. OK, PAR, SLP)"}, "blastoise_surf_pp": {"type": "integer", "description": "Remaining PP for Blastoise's Surf"}}, "required": ["trainee_exp_remaining", "mewtwo_hp", "mewtwo_status", "mewtwo_psychic_pp", "blastoise_hp", "blastoise_status", "blastoise_surf_pp"]}
